'''Sonn-Vi''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] that was one of the member of the [[Three]], the Voss secular government, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. His personality was regarded as being calm and authoritative, and he often was the decisive member of the body. He also usually acted as spokesman for the Three.<ref name="TOR" />
